definitions.short: a descendant of the fourth generation, i.e. great great grandchild
definitions.full: H7256. ribbea [ רִבֵּעַ ] adjective pertaining to the fourth (in a series); — plural in phrase וְעַלרִֿבֵּעִים עַלֹשִֿׁלֵּשִׁים i.e. those belonging to the 3rd and 4th Generations, Exod 20:5 (E) = Deut 5:9 ; Exod 34:17 (J), Num 14:18 (JE), compare 1 above
